newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup writes off Sabena stake.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup writes off Sabena stake.

text.p: SAirGroup, which includes the Swissair airline, said it would fully write down the value of its 49.5 percent stake in Belgian partner Sabena SA in its 1996 accounts.
SAirGroup said in a statement after a meeting of its board of directors that the value of the stake was 267 million francs.
SAirGroup, previously known as the Swissair Group, acquired the stake in Sabena in 1995 with the aim of developing a leading European airline group.

SAirGroup wanted to strengthen its strategic position on its home continent and utilise synergies in revenue and expenditure, not only between the two airlines, but in the broader alliance with Delta Air Lines, Singapore Airlines and Austrian Airlines.
"Swissair and Sabena will continue to pursue these objectives," SAirGroup said.

However, with Sabena's disappointing 1996 loss of 8.9 billion Belgian francs, or 353 million Swiss francs, Swissair is constrained to adjusting downward the value of its holding in Sabena, SAirGroup said.
